details.publicNotes:
Hemadae queens form when a group of hemadae overseers strikes out from a hive that's grown too big. They find a new cave system to inhabit and submerge themselves in an acidic concoction that melts their steel hides and lets them meld into one consciousness. Fledgling queens are unable to move, so their first instruction to their drone underlings is typically to build a war machine fit for their station.

Hemadae queens consolidate reports from across the hive to detect threats and opportunities for expansion and direct their overseers accordingly. Queens rarely enter battle unless an intruder poses an existential threat to the hive. When they do fight, they gather hordes of hemadae at their side and drive them into a frenzy with their rallying cry. For hemadae who fall in battle, there is no greater honor than to be absorbed into the queen's body to restore the queen's vitality.

Hemadaes are metallic wasplike creatures with a few parts from humans or other mortal ancestries eerily hanging out from their body. A hemadae hive is a complex hybrid of a smith's forge and a massive wasp nest. Most hemadaes are drones, which do the grunt work inside and outside the hive. Particularly accomplished drones are transformed into overseers, egotistical and talented crafters who direct hordes of drones and control clockwork constructs in ceaseless toil. A single hemadae queen rules each hive, imposing her will through telepathic commands to the overseers. To communicate with each other, hemadae overseers and drones use a discordant language made from mandible clicks and the banging and scraping of metal.

Hemadaes reproduce by infecting other creatures with their genetic material. Their bite infects a horrific disease that slowly turns the victim's skin into an outer shell of metal, trapping them inside while the venom digests them alive. The primordial soup that remains then metamorphoses into a drone.

Prized Prisoners

Hemadae queens are artisans with few equals, but even they recognize that a few non-hemadae rise to their level. Artisan queens do their best to capture anyone with crafting skills more developed than their own. Rather than being converted into new hemadae, these prisoners are forced to work on behalf of the hive. Few escape hemadae captivity alive, although some have managed to do so by sabotaging hemadae engines of war or by encoding secret messages on ammunition destined to be used against heroes.

A hemadae queen can feel the minds of nearby members of their hive, detecting their locations as a precise sense.

Trigger A creature uses a concentrate action within 60 feet of the hemadae queen

Effect The queen assaults the mind of the triggering creature, dealing @Damage[2d6[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:30|basic] save). On a failure, the queen puppets the creature's muscles to move them 10 feet in any direction (or 20 feet on a critical failure); this is forced movement. This movement does not disrupt the action, but it might move the creature out of range of their intended target. Cold Contractions As hemadae drone, except the piercing weakness is 10.

Requirements The hemadae queen is adjacent to a dead hemadae and is not at full Hit Points

Effect The hemadae queen absorbs the body into their own, regaining @Damage[5d8[healing]] Hit Points.

The hemadae queen fires one of the four cannons affixed to their abdomen. Creatures in a @Template[type:line|distance:50] take 6d6 damage (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] save). Each cannon deals a different damage type and has additional effect on a critical failure. She can instead choose to fire two cannons simultaneously; if she does, she can't use Instruments of War again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Instruments of War]]{1d4 rounds}.

The hemadae queen releases a mental pulse in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:40] that harms their enemies but inspires their minions. The screech deals @Damage[12d6[mental]|options:area-damage] damage to non-hemadae creatures in the area (@Check[will|dc:28|basic] save). Hemadae in the area can instead use a reaction to Fly, Step, or Stride; one hemadae in the area, of the hive queen's choice, can instead use a reaction to Strike. The hive queen can't use Mind over Metal for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.
